notes.title: Update CL25441
notes.notes:
✨ What’s New & Improved

New Asia Server Online – faster, smoother connections for our players in the region.

New Map Unlocked – dive into fresh terrain with unique challenges and landscapes.

Landscape Overhaul – environments feel more alive and immersive than ever.

Bot Health Reduced – fairer battles and tighter pacing.

Building Defense Boosted – stronger outposts mean more strategic depth.

Space Station Brightened – visibility and atmosphere improved for smoother navigation.

We truly believe this is our strongest release yet and can’t wait for you to experience it. Thank you for being part of the Outerstellar journey. 



Feel free to pop into our Discord for feedback and chats !

notes.title: Update CL25401
notes.notes:
Thanks to everyone who reported issues in our Discord, your assistance is hugely appreciated. Welcome, also, to all the new players trying the game for the first time! this latest update brings a new map and some QoL improvements, as well as some critical fixes.


 New map, smaller and easier to get around
 Reduced fall damage significantly, and increased water movement speed
 Reduced acid biome damage and fixed the issue causing constant damage in fire/acid biome even with correct suit
 Added leeches back in
 Fixed a couple of rare crashes reported via the automated system (thanks for submitting!)
 Adjusted recycle properties and reduced world fabricator rates

notes.title: July 2024 Update
notes.notes:
July 2024 Update has landed! Bringing brand new items to level up your combat, and new tech and changes to take the grind out of the early and late game.

[previewyoutube=N0TrdU_kdOs;full][/previewyoutube]


.:: NEW FEATURES ::.

 Added Metal and Carbon Fabricators that consume aura and power to generate the resource.
 Added T3 wind turbine.
 Added Mini Turret for additional support during firefight.
 Added barricade deployable item.
 Added healing beacon deployable item.
 Added highlight to dropped items.
 New landscape and monuments moved further apart.
 PvP kill events are pushed as global notifications and temporary map markers.


.:: CUSTOM DEDICATED SERVERS ::.

 Dedicated server package - host your own private servers!
 Added private server password support.
 Advanced server customization is possible via configuration files.
 Documentation for server hosting available online.


.:: GAMEPLAY AND BALANCE ::.

 Increased the defence of T3 Aura base walls.
 Reduced the cost of T3 Aura base walls and upkeep.
 Reduced aura drop from meteor event.
 Increased BC build block radius from 30 to 50m.
 Compound walls and gates can now be placed much further from buildings.
 Advanced weapon mods no longer craftable and must be found.
 Reworked the barrels and drops for lockers and barrels.
 Barrels auto-loot with most weapons.
 Increased Uplink stash slots to 24.
 Player network range increased from 300m to 500m.
 Reworked weapon accuracy so firing from the hip is not so penalized now.
 Arc Furnace in the Refinery and Space Station now smelts at 10x speed, 2x yield, and only one person can interact at a time.


.:: IMPROVEMENTS ::.

 Landscape deployables are now placeable on rocks etc, too.
 Building Privilege UI icon now shows protection time remaining.
 Increased size of airdrop and is much more visible now.
 Added nearby map icons to the compass widget.
 Reworked map icons and emphasized they can be named.
 Simplified tutorial to improve situations where players would get stuck.
 Reworked weapon attentuation so distant gunfire can be heard much further away, and easier to guage distance.
 Added fire and acid biome ambience sounds.


.:: MISCELLANEOUS FIXES ::.

 Terraformer landscape holes fixed.
 Fixed sticky bombs not flashing.
 Fixed a bug causing no lootdrops/meteors after savegame invalidation.
 Fixed exploit accessing terraformer black room from underneath.
 Improved excessive rubberbanding on connections with consistent packetloss.
 Fixed a bug where monsters would not be affected by splash damage.
 Fix the issue where items could easily fall behind the warehouse desks, and improved the ability to pick them up.
 Improved the flashlight clipping through some suits.
 Fixed damage on metal bolts and rockets.
 Added shadow casting to base lights to stop leaking.

notes.title: Patch Notes for Hotfix CL23966

HUGE thanks to our community who reported a range of issues with the recent update, that we've worked hard to fix! Including Xercodo, Rocknrolla86, Trappy, RevolutionX, LAG, Mertve40k, Hop, Luna, Schmoobler, Max, and many more; please keep the reports coming!

Bug fixes

 Disabled turrets firing at AI as they can't damage them right now
 Duplicated+moved teleporter signs to be more obvious
 Increased depth that foundations can be placed underwater
 Turrets always target bones on players now which means they also shoot correctly when downed
 Added or enlarged no build zones to various monuments (Quad ports, Exhaust_tall, Satellite, Silo, Refinery entrance, Warehouse)
 Fixed issues when interacting with chests in shelving units
 Modified staircase collision which should fix rare falling through bug
 Fixed the very nasty bug where a full inventory would cause loss of all crafting in-progress
 Fixed a rare client crash involving items and inventory
 Temporary fix for some holes in Terraformer landscape
 Fixed turret firing sound getting stuck on and not attenuating
 Fixed some storm noises not affected by volume slider
 Added missing no build zones to various monuments
 Ranged weapons with scopes now show hit markers


Balance changes

 Plasma turret clip from 120 to 40
 Reduced HP of turrets from 1000 to 500
 Added black decoder to warehouse
 Fixed recipe for Adv. Protection Core
 Fixed plasma sniper accidentally doing double damage and reduced base damage of both snipers
 Significant reduction on med crafting costs
 Lowered T1 shotgun damage
 Increased meteor health
 Removed broken spawners in Refinery black room
 Buildings can now be placed deeper under water

notes.title: Patch Notes CL21516
notes.notes:
A new Outerstellar patch is available. All progress has been reset and we have some new features and bug fixes for you.
We are working hard on some major features that many of you have requested. We are not ready to share much yet, but stay tuned for some updates from us on what will be coming to the game soon.

NEW FEATURES
[olist]
 Added the Chatter-Box deployable. This allows you to chat with other players on the server, and streams kill events. It keeps all messages that were sent while you are connected to the server. You can either craft it and deploy it to your base or use one of the terminals in the Space Station.
 Added a new interactive Tutorial that will walk new players through the basics of the game. It guides you through building and securing your first base up to upgrading it with metal. Experienced players can turn this off in the options menu.
 Shutters are now interactable and can be opened and closed. This should make them quite useful to attack from when your base is under attack. Don't forget to lock them!
 The Bar Area Space Station but no interactive elements yet.
[/olist]

GAMEPLAY
[olist]
 Base windows have had their HP and Defense upgraded to equivalent to T1 buildings.
 Placing a Building Controller now authorizes the placing player immediately, no need to interact with it after placing.
 Aura Fuel item has been added.
 Flamethrower is now loaded with Aura Fuel and does increased fire damage, more quickly.
 50% chance that common crates will drop between 1-2 Aura Fuel.
 Sniper, Automatic Rifle and Rocket Launcher now require Aura Rifle Chassis that are extremely rare.
 All suits except black and white eso have increased 10% physical protection.
 Icon and Mesh for CrudeAuraBomb and Aura bomb has been swapped.
 Acid, Fire and Rad buffs increased protection from 30% to 50% for 30 seconds.
[/olist]

MINOR
[olist]
 Made some minor changes to increase UI visibility in dark environments.
 Hovering the item image in the Crafting Window now displays maximum Durability / Ammo.
[/olist]

BUGS
[olist]
 Fixed a bug where it was possible for shutters to be placed inside walls with windows.
 Fixed a minor issue where the item name was overflowing inside the Crafting Window.
 Fixed a bug where some keypad locations were inside the door.
 Fixed a bug where it was possible to uplink the Mass Aura Bomb.
[/olist]

notes.title: Space Station Update
notes.notes:
Welcome, players, to the new Outerstellar patch. All progress has been reset and we are thrilled to introduce the new Space Station and a new map to the game! The Space Station serves as the main hub of the server and lets you spawn inside it when you join for the first time or when you die on the planet. You can meet other colonizers, equip items from the Uplink Storage, and drop down into the world or use the teleporters to spawn in your base. Stay tuned for future Space Station modules that are already in the works. We are eager to see how this change affects the gameplay.

ITS A WHOLE NEW WORLD
[olist]
 The planet has shifted once again. Brace yourselves for a new map that contains all the same elements but arranged in a new interesting way.
[/olist]
NEW FEATURES
[olist]
 Added new consumable items that allow you to temporarily increase your protection stats, great for looting in dangerous areas.
 Added new ‘Space Station Uplink’ deployable that allows you to send items to the Space Station.
 Several seasonal Christmas-related changes. Can you find them all?
[/olist]
DEPLOYABLE UPDATES
[olist]
 Increased health for solar, wind, and chest deployables. They should be much harder to destroy with melee weapons now.
 Fences and Gates are now slightly larger.
 Compound Walls T2 now have twice the health of T1.
 Changed crafting recipe of Compound Walls T2.
 Changed the colors of windows and shutters to better match their respective building part tier colors.
 Renamed Respawn Pad to Teleport Pad.
 Made some changes to make deployable placement easier, more improvements are coming soon.
[/olist]
MONUMENT UPDATES
[olist]
 Removed an epic chest from the top of the landing pad monument.
 Fixed several see-through meshes in the landing pad monument.
 Deployables in the monuments should not run out of energy as quickly as before.
 Deployables in monuments now show their names when looked at.
[/olist]
BASE UPDATES
[olist]
 Several changes to defense, attack and ammo cost values makes raiding more difficult.
 Building Parts are now slightly larger. This should allow for more space to place deployables.
 Compound Gates/Walls must be placed near existing buildings now.
[/olist]
WORLD RELATED UPDATES 
[olist]
 Added stars to the skybox on the planet that appear depending on the time of day.
[/olist]
WEAPON, ARMOR & DAMAGE UPDATES
[olist]
 Increased damage of picks. Slow animation would give them low DPS.
 Reduced damage of Strange Sword from 50 to 45.
 Flamethrower now does only fire damage.
[/olist]
ITEM UPDATES
[olist]
 Renamed Aura Berry to Aura Funghi.
 Aura Berry and Aura Funghi now stack up to 100.
 Adjusted the time it takes to craft an Aura Core.
[/olist]
UI UPDATES
[olist]
 Combined defense protection/absorb stat into one value.
 Updated the grid line texture on the map window.
[/olist]
SOUND
[olist]
 A major pass on every sound in the game has been completed. Instead of everything being loud, you should now be able to hear a mix of quiet and loud sounds.
 Doubled the range of footstep sounds.
 Adjusted explosion attenuation to sound more natural and not travel as far (approx half the map now).
[/olist]
BUGS
[olist]
 Fixed a bug where Aura would sometimes spawn inside objects in the world.
 Fixed a bug where some suits did not display as expected in the suit storage. 
 Fixed a bug where not all ceilings had the same thickness, resulting in some deployables not being able to be placed inside bases.
 Fixed a bug where the recycler would sometimes not return any items even if there was a 100% recycle chance.
 Fixed a bug that allowed naughty thieves to “climb up” doors by jumping onto locks.
 Fixed a bug in the documentation where the melee attack rate was not accounting for combo/transition times.
 Fixed a bug where picking up a deployable would sometimes not work even if there was enough space in the player’s inventory.
 Fixed a bug where muzzle flash of various guns was in the center of the gun.
 Fixed a bug where it was possible to shoot in any direction while free look was enabled.
 Fixed a bug where sometimes firing rocket straight after reloading could result in a dud.
[/olist]

notes.title: Beta Release
notes.notes:
REGISTER FOR THE PLAYTEST HERE  ːsteamthumbsupː

Outerstellar beta release
We're excited to announce our first beta release 21st-24th of September. During this time, the game is free to play. We welcome you to have fun and offer feedback so we can improve and polish the game for Early Access in December. 

How to join the playtest
Go to the store page and hit the Request Access button where it says Join the Outerstellar Playtest.

About the game
Outerstellar, a gripping sci-fi survival PvP game that drops you onto a dangerous and mysterious planet. Explore the barren wasteland left behind by failed colonists and face the harsh reality of a world unfit for human life. Gather resources, build a shelter, and fight to survive each night in a game that challenges your every move. But survival is just the beginning, as the secrets of this strange planet await.

Featuring
[olist]
 A detailed and beautiful persistent world with dynamic time of day and weather.
 Comprehensive research tree and crafting system allows you to prioritise the technologies important to your team and gameplay style.
 Harvest plants and ore, and scavenge for resources in the abandoned areas around the map. Find or unlock items allowing deeper access into these mysterious structures.
 Build a base, upgrade it, power it and fill it with useful equipment to control the resources of that area.
 Craft advanced weaponry to defend, or to raid other players.
 Join an official server, or host your own and use the extensive server mod tools to customize the experience.
[/olist]
